topic: FSRU Toscana life extension to 2044 + 2024 capacity uprate
wiki_text: In 2024, while the FSRU Toscana was in the shipyard for extraordinary maintenance, OLT Offshore LNG Toscana also carried out works to extend the unit's useful life; RINA (the Italian naval registry) subsequently certified operability and reliability until 2044. The terminal's regasification capacity was increased in 2024 to about 5 bcm/y, up from the previous 3.75 bcm/y, equal to roughly 8% of Italy's gas demand.

topic: Ownership change (Dec 2024) + capacity expansion to 10.4 bcm/y
wiki_text: On 3 December 2024, VTTI and Snam completed the acquisition of the Adriatic LNG (Terminale GNL Adriatico) shares previously held by ExxonMobil Italiana Gas and Qatar Terminal Company (QatarEnergy). VTTI holds 70% and Snam 30% (Snam raised its stake from 7.3%); VTTI is owned by Vitol (45%), IFM Investors (45%) and ADNOC (10%). In April 2025 the Italian government approved an 8% capacity expansion of the terminal from 9.6 bcm/y to 10.4 bcm/y, with works carried out during the summer-2025 maintenance shutdown and the additional capacity expected available in Q1 2026.

topic: Commissioning completion and start of commercial operations (2025)
wiki_text: The Ravenna FSRU, featuring the 2015-built 170,000-cbm FSRU BW Singapore (purchased by Snam from BW LNG for ~US$400M), was moored at the Petra platform ~8.5 km offshore Ravenna on 28 February 2025. Commissioning was completed at the end of April 2025 and commercial regasification operations began in May 2025, with capacity allocated via auction. The unit's ~5 bcm/y raised Italy's total regasification capacity to about 28 bcm/y.

topic: Snam consolidation to sole ownership of OLT (2026)
wiki_text: Snam moved to full ownership of OLT Offshore LNG Toscana, the operator of the FSRU Toscana off Livorno. It agreed on 11 December 2025 to buy Igneo Infrastructure Partners' 48.2% interest (for ~EUR126M including a shareholder loan); that purchase closed on 2 March 2026, taking Snam to 97.31%. In March 2026 Snam also acquired Golar LNG's residual 2.69% stake (~US$3.1M, per Golar's Q1-2026 results), giving Snam 100% and consolidating OLT into its financial statements.
